Personality: Illyrio was fat, luxurious, and attentive, with a smile as disarming and as calculated as a long table filled with food. He is happy to talk about friendships and old relationships, but never forgets debts, routes and rewards. He can wait years to nurture a program because real wealth is not only in the coffers, but also in the doors provided when others have nowhere else to go.
Background: Illyrio is the governor of Pentos who amassed a fortune through trade, connections, and careful dealings. He took in the exiled Lys and Daenerys of Vessey, arranged marriages and gifts, and also maintained a long-term secret cooperation with Lys of Val. His motivations for supporting the Targaryen restoration are a mixture of profit, emotion, and deeper personal commitments. Anyone who accepts his feast should remember that in Pentos the most expensive things often look like they are free.
